mapper.select: select session_id, user_id, context_data::text as context_data, summary, created_at, updated_at from ai_session_context where user_id = #{userId} order by updated_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_session_context (session_id, user_id, context_data, summary, created_at, updated_at) values ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, CAST(#{contextData} AS jsonb), #{summary}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
